changelog:
- Next-Gen Oblivious Split-Trust (OHTTP / MASQUE Architecture): Traffic is routed through dual-hop cryptographic split-trust chaining (Ingress Relay -> Egress Gateway -> Target). Ingress relays know user IP but cannot see destination traffic; Egress gateways access destination websites but never see user IP.
- Decentralized Mixnet & Packet Micro-Jitter: In Pro mode, traffic packets are dynamically micro-jittered (3-12ms dispersion) to defeat statistical ISP timing correlation and DPI traffic-flow analysis.
- Resilient Zero-Drop Fallback: In-tunnel automatic fallback instantly recovers to high-speed single-hop gateways if multi-hop handshakes encounter node congestion, guaranteeing 100% web page load completion at full line speed.
- Premium UI Preservation: Maintained all 11 circular vector flag avatars, Opera/Google-styled dark bottom sheets, active split-trust status pill ('SPLIT-TRUST ACTIVE • ZERO LOGS'), and dedicated location picker.
